CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_tes(txkey INT)
RETURNS FLOAT AS
$$
DECLARE
    engagement_score INT;
BEGIN
    SELECT
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'High' THEN 3
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Medium' THEN 2
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Low' THEN 1
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
    INTO engagement_score
    FROM treatmentbasics
    WHERE txkey = txkey;
    
    RETURN engagement_score;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
